name: RollCo: Sunday Rollers Banded Badge Hunt
description:
🥽 ROLL EASY - BANDED RIDES
Welcome to The Rolling Collective (RollCo).
Our rides are built around shared momentum and riding Forward, Together.
A friendly, no-drop ride is designed to be welcoming and social. This is a great entry point if you’re new to RollCo.
What to expect:
• Banded ride - ride at your own pace
• No drop
• Leaders will communicate throughout the ride
Ride within yourself, look out for others, and enjoy the roll.

Why Join Rolling Collective?
We’re more than a club — we’re a global community of riders who support each other, grow together, and celebrate every ride, whether it’s a grind, a badge hunt, or a race. Join us on Discord, connect with fellow riders, and be part of something bigger.

Forward, Together

name: The Zwifty Fifty with DZR
description:
**The Zwifty Fifty: When 25 is Too Little and 100 is Too Much**

DZR brings to you the Goldilocks of Zwift racing intensity and endurance balance. With weekly races at about 50 km, the races are not too short and intensive to build stamina, and not too long and time-consuming to actually get done. They are just right. And they are on every Sunday at 14:45 CET | 8:45 AM EST.

To add to the fun and keep a high intensity throughout the race, we have included bonus second sprints. These sprints are on flats when the finish is on a KOM and on KOMs when the finish is flat.

No powerups, no zpower, no TT bikes, HRM enforced.

For all the details, including stage information, bonus sprints, rules, and registration links, visit the official website for The Zwifty Fifty at http://dzrracingseries.com/the-zwifty-fifty/

name: 3R Endurance Steady Ride
description:
3R Chase Endurance Ride

Join us for an exhilarating 3R Group Ride Event, where teamwork isn’t just encouraged, it’s essential!

This description does not include the C endurance ride, this is as usual a normal C endurance ride.

In this Chase Endurance Ride, we embark on a 100km journey, following the same course as our Steady State B group. The aim? To gradually close the gap and merge with the Steady State B Group around the 80km mark, setting the stage for an exciting final stretch.

This ride is about group effort and shared responsibility. We expect each rider to contribute, taking turns on the front with pulls of approximately 4.5-5.0 w/kg. Remember, it’s a chase, not a free ride, so we kindly ask that you join in the spirit of collective effort rather than just drafting throughout.

When our group catches up with the Steady State B group, it’s a chance to mix things up! If you’re feeling strong, keep up the pace with the A group. Alternatively, if you’re in the mood for a more relaxed ride, feel free to settle in with the B group.

Remember, this isn’t a race, but a part of our #ProStyleTraining series, designed to support your training goals in a fun, social setting. We love a bit of friendly banter and encourage you to share your experiences and feedback on our Facebook page at https://www.facebook.com/groups/ClubWorldBicycleRelief/. Let’s ride, raise, race and enjoy together with #Team3R.

name: Pride Run
description:
Join with members of the LGBTQ+ community as we stride with Pride! 

Runs are hosted by LGBTQ Zwifters Club and we invite you to join our weekly rainbow run! In some runs you will find a leader to make it social and help keep you motivated. If you are in training for a duathlon or triathlon, you can even join a Pride Ride before your run, since runs are scheduled 30 min after each Pride ride ends. Our runs are inclusive, we value diversity and courage, and we are always respectful. Social chat may involve LGBTQ+ topics so please come with an open heart and open mind. 

If you want to learn more about our Club and socials, please visit: https://lgbtq-zwifters.com/

name: The Mountain Massif
description:
Every great race has a defining climb.

This event is built for riders who thrive when the road tilts skyward. Expect a demanding route featuring sustained ascents, decisive hills, and relentless terrain that rewards patience, tactical awareness, and exceptional endurance.

The strongest rider doesn’t always win—but the smartest one often does.

Conserve your energy in the wheels. Read the race. Cover the moves that matter. Then, when the gradient bites and your rivals begin to fade, commit without hesitation.

The decisive attack will come. The question is whether you’ll be the one launching it—or chasing it.

There are no easy kilometres here. Every climb is an opportunity to gain time. Every descent is a chance to recover. Every decision shapes the final result.

When the summit is in sight, hesitation is the difference between victory and watching the podium ride away.

Race with discipline. Climb with conviction. Finish with nothing left to give.

Rules:
Heart Rate monitor required and Zwift Power for official results.

More information:
For more information check out the Mountain Massif website www.mountainmassif.com, follow on Instagram @mountain_massif, Facebook @mountainmassif and join our Zwift Club, by clicking the following link https://www.zwift.com/clubs/mountainmassif/home

description:

On Sunday, take part in ten back to back races on the shortest routes in Zwift!

2 - The Bel Lap (2.04km)
3 - Macaron (2.6km)
4 - Glasgow Crit Circuit (3.26km)
5 - Glasgow Reverse (4.21km)

7 - Duchy Estate (4.7km)
8 - LaGuardia Loop Reverse (5.2km)
9 - Queen's Highway (5.6km)

Riders are categorised into 5 groups using their Compound Score (NB: To calculate your compound score multiply your 90 day best 5 minute power watts by watts oer kilo, eg 200*2=400 if your best 5 minute power is 200w as a 100kg rider)

Category A: 1700 and above
Category B: 1200-1700
Category C: 900-1200
Category D: 600-900
Category E: 0-600

Riders will all start together, but you will be able to see which riders are in your category by the letter on their jersey.

Big Heads and Boost Power ups will be in action! Every rider will receive two boost power ups in the pen (which give you a 1 second boost of power). Use them wisely!

Riders must be using a Smart Trainer, Smart Bike or Power Meter and have a Heart Rate Monitor paired to join the events.

Overall standings are taken from your overall time across all the stages that you take part in, see the results here: https://zwiftpower.com/league.php?id=3345

name: RO4H Rookie Group Ride
description: Welcome to the RO4H Rookie Group Ride! This event is a relaxed, supportive teaching ride designed to help Zwifters of all experience levels learn the basics of Zwifting and group riding in a friendly, judgment-free environment. We aim for an average pace of 16–19 mph (26–30 kph) in the leader's peloton. Routes are mostly flat, though rolling terrain may cause natural pace changes. Sweepers are available to help riders reconnect or ride comfortably at their own pace. If you're new to group rides or unsure about cycling terms, don't worry—you're in the right place. Many riders here are beginners, and no one is judging. Just click the orange square with the white plus sign and join us. Rookie Tip: We recommend using the Zwift Companion App for communication, navigation, and situational awareness. You can find it at: https://www.zwift.com/companion. Join the RO4H Rookie Ride, learn, ride, and have fun!

name: Herd Classics #2 - Herd Winter Racing
description:
Herd Classics: six weeks, six different races.

This year Herd Racing is taking all their best races and putting them in one big competition.
Take on legendary Zwift courses while going on a trip down memory lane. Each week brings
us a new challenge and each week we will crown an overall and Herd Racing champion in
all categories. For the hardcore racers that will be joining us each week there is also a Herd
Classic Championship.

Week 1: The Stampede
Our ITT format, pick your best TT-bike to set the fastest time possible.

Week 2: Herd Winter Racing (also known as Herd Beginner Racing)
A mass start scratch race. Find your group and race them to the finishline.

Week 3: Herd of Mountain Goats
Climbing, lots and lots of climbing.

Week 4: Bullseye Point Race
First across the line points racing. Beat everyone to the line to score the most points.

Week 5: Climbers Gambit
Our Hill Climb event. Only your time on the climb segment counts.

Week 6: Herd Summer Racing League
It’s not really summer anymore, but we’re always in for a good FTS points race.

As a part of the trip down memory lane we’re letting everyone weigh in on the courses that
will be used. So if you want your vote to count join the Herd Racing facebook page:
https://www.facebook.com/groups/zHerdRacing

description:
Hosted by the Invictus Games Foundation. Below the link to the sign up for the event:

Join our social ride led by members of the Invictus Games international community of serving military personnel and veterans who use cycling to recover from injury.

A sub-2.0 w/kg (Cat D) weekly group ride with the goal of keeping the group together. This event is open to any ability including those who use handcycles, recumbents, trikes, tandems and standard bikes.

name: Zwift Racing League Recon Ride (Team Fearless)
description:
This ZRL Group Recon Ride is led by Team Fearless (https://www.zwift.com/clubs/12108e14-08dd-4563-85b8-e3f8d91394c6).

Zwift Racing League Group Recon Rides are the official non-competitive Group Rides. Each one is hosted/run by a participating club and will feature racing tips and tricks for the race ahead, an opportunity to ask questions relating to Zwift Racing League and to preview the full course for Tuesday’s ZRL races.

THE AIM
With experienced ride leaders and Zwifters from a reputable Zwift Club, this is your opportunity to ask questions about all things ZRL-related. You'll be able to learn useful course and team tactics and if you are new to ZRL - perhaps even find a team to race with too!

There are multiple Group Recon Rides to choose from each day at various times and each will operate at the advertised paces (pace is based on your Zwift Pace Group).

WHAT IS THE ZRL?
Introducing the spectacular Zwift Racing League (ZRL) - a turbocharged online bike racing extravaganza that's rewriting the rules of competition. With a staggering 180 community divisions, 1,800 electrifying teams, and a whopping 14,000 fierce racers per 6-week round, the ZRL stands as the undisputed heavyweight champion of online bike racing competitions worldwide.

This high-octane spectacle is masterfully orchestrated by our powerhouse partners, WTRL, who leave no stone unturned in delivering an unparalleled racing experience. But remember, this race is an invitation-only affair, so if you dare to join the ranks of speed demons and thrill-seekers, you'll need to hitch a ride with one of the esteemed existing teams. Fear not, though, for WTRL's website (www.WTRL.racing) is your portal to all the insider intel - schedule, rules, and even a team that perfectly aligns with your fiery spirit!

If you want to gather your own team, you register for the next Round of ZRL at www.wtrl.racing/zwift-racing-league/.

#zrlrecon #wtrl #zrl #fearless

name: Seattle Baby Steps 1.0-1.3 w/kg
description:
Are you looking for a supportive beginner or recovery ride?  If so welcome to Seattle Baby Steps! This weekly ride will be paced at an average of 1.0-1.3 w/kg on the flats and is intended for riders who are newer, younger, older, and recovering from injuries.  This is an enjoyable and conversational social ride where your participation is encouraged.  Baby Steps' goal is to help you build strength and confidence to try the hundreds of advanced rides, races, and events that are available every week on Zwift.

We haven't jumped on to the Discord bandwagon yet but join us on our Facebook page at: Seattle Baby Steps - Weekly Zwift Group Ride to stay in touch with the group and to share your thoughts and ask Zwift and other cycling-related questions. https://www.facebook.com/search/top/?q=seattle%20baby%20steps%20-%20weekly%20zwift%20group%20ride

GROUP RIDE ETIQUETTE FOR NEWCOMERS

Please respect the ride leader's pace and instructions. This is not a race and the ride leader will not chase anyone riding off the front of the group. If you feel the need to stretch your legs, do so on the sprints and then prepare to regroup immediately afterward. Faster riders are encouraged to sweep in the back to assist less strong riders who may be struggling to rejoin the group after sprints and inclines. Sprinkle Ride Ons far and wide to encourage and delight your fellow riders! Join in on the conversation (on-screen text), but be mindful of the younger folks (i.e., children) who join the ride from time to time.

As long as you turn those pedals you will stay with the group and even if you have a dropout, the sweep team will do its best to help you back to the group. You can sign up early via the web or mobile app and late join is enabled.

All riders will appear in the same kit (unlocked at the finish) and you can optionally add (PACK) after your name to show support of the group. Please visit the Coffee Shop if you need a break especially on longer climbs. #coffeetogether 😊

Finally, if you are just starting your Zwift experience, please join our Facebook group and PACK Club for tips on group riding, friendly advice and to answer any questions you have.

name: OTR Snap Crackle Pop Punch Time
description:
Snap Crackle Pop Punch Time is a group ride, race & interval training all rolled into one fun challenging event. Unique “race” scoring, where results in ZwiftPower are based on sum of segment times on a route with punchy climbs and/or sprints. Group rides together at ~2wkg, and ride leader provides guidance and lead-outs to smash a segment; then regroup, rinse & repeat. New route every week.

Multiple time slots on Fri-Sun, including Fri Atlantic, Sun APAC and Sun Americas/EMEA.
Riders need to join ZwiftPower.com to see their results as sum of segment times.

Event links: https://www.zwift.com/events/tag/snapcracklepop
Weekly results (across all time slots): https://zwiftpower.com/league.php?id=2656
In-ride conversation (“SCP Ride” channel): https://discord.gg/B52qdExaW2
Chat, banter and results: https://discord.gg/HNzvx98srF

Group ride with all cats together at ~2w/kg. Yellow beacon / ride leader (when present) will provide instructions for each segment, and drop the fence when it's time to punch/sprint. Fence is for guidance only (non-zapping).

Ride at a relaxed pace between the timed segments.
Work together to optimize draft for faster segment times.
Slow or stop with yellow beacon after each segment to regroup.

All categories start in a single pen.
Results split per WKG category in ZwiftPower.
No power ups, default drafting, no TT bikes.

One of our regular SCP routes is 3.5 laps of Innsbruckring, with 4x Leg Snappers plus 3x sprints (stopping to regroup on the kicker in between). The challenge is to achieve sub 4 mins for the sum of 7 segment times for cats A/B (that's 45 secs per snapper plus 20 secs per sprint), sub 5 mins for cat C, and sub 7 mins for cat D. Best time to beat is 3:33.
Historical results for Leg Snapper: https://zwiftpower.com/league.php?id=1322

name: EVO CC Race Series
description:
CATEGORY ENFORCEMENT IS ENABLED FOR ALL EVO RACES!

What is Category Enforcement? 

Category Enforcement will prevent Zwifters from entering a category they are not eligible for.  Our goal is to increase fairness in racing.

HOW DOES IT WORK?

- Zwift checks a racer's past performance using VO2 max and FTP to determine their race category.
- Racers can join a category at or above their category. For example, if you are "C" category, you can race in C, B, or A category. You will not be able to race in the D category and the option to join will be absent.

Welcome to EVO race series. Shorter more compact races for the rider looking for an effective high intensity race. Start fast, hang on in the middle, then sprint for the win at the finish. Expect to push your heart rate to its maximum. Sprinkle a few of these into your training plan and watch your fitness grow.

To make racing as fair as possible we have enforced a few minor rules that will result in automatic disqualification on ZwiftPower.

All riders must wear a heart rate monitor
Riding in an incorrect category.

zPower riders will be disqualified in A, B, and C Podium. zPower is allowed in the D category. Race details and final results will be available at www.zwiftpower.com

#evo

name: SUNDAY SUFFERFEST - BLAME STIG!
description:
Every Sunday. Intervals, suffering & absolutely no accountability.  

Welcome to Stig’s weekly exercise in psychological warfare!  

INTERVALS ARE MANDATORY. SURVIVAL IS OPTIONAL. 

Expect brutal efforts, questionable recovery periods, screaming legs and several deeply personal conversations with your smart trainer. 

Stig calls it training. Your legs call it attempted murder.  

Ride together. Suffer together. Question your life choices together.  

If your FTP drops — BLAME STIG.  
If your legs explode — BLAME STIG.  
If you see God during the final interval — tell Him Stig sent you. 

NO MERCY. NO EXCUSES. NO REFUNDS.  

Clip in, sinners. Sunday school is in session. 

THE INTERVALS ARE REAL. THE SUFFERING IS REAL. STIG'S REMORSE IS NOT. 

#BLAMESTIG

name: Steed Cycles Stay at Home Workout
description: The Steed Cycles Stay at Home Workout is the perfect 'sweet-spot' workout to maintain your cycling fitness while outdoor group riding is restricted.  After a short warm-up, the Steed Cycles ride leader will ramp up to 'club pace' of 3 watts/kg, slowing down briefly every once every lap of the course to regroup. name: PACK Run Hill Training: Surrey
description:
PACK Hill Training is a group workout designed to help runners get familiar with running with incline. This is a free run event meaning there is no set pace you must go, but there will be incline prompts that attempt to mimic the terrain of the course. The inclines are based on distance, so you will always be given prompts based on your progression in the workout. If some of the gradients are too challenging for you, feel free to decrease the incline, but don't make it too easy. The leader will typically follow the pace chart below, but may adjust depending on the group dynamics.

Note: We will not always be matching Zwift gradients, so it is important to pay attention to the instructions. Typically the adjusted incline will be half of what is being displayed in the upper righthand corner.

As a general guide:
--------------------------
0 - 1% = 10.2kph / 6.3 mph
2% - 9.9 kph / 6.2 mph
3% = 9.7 kph / 6.0 mph
4% = 9.3 kph / 5.8 mph
5% = 9 kph / 5.6 mph
6% = 8.7 kph / 5.4 mph
7% = 7.4 kph / 5.2 mph
--------------------------

If you'd like Zwift to record your elevation in the fit file, you'll need to either have a direct connect treadmill or use an app like Pascal's Runcline for iOS, TSS app for iOS, or Runn module from North Pole Engineering.

Finally, if the hills don't wear you out, there will be an optional 500 meter sprint to the finish and optional after party of 2-4km to boot!

So put PACK in your name, get your black shirt and shorts on, and let's tackle those hills!

https://www.facebook.com/groups/zwiftpack/

name: USMeS Operational Reach
description:
Welcome to USMeS Operational Reach.
In military terms, operational reach is the distance and duration a unit can effectively operate before combat power starts to fade, and the supplies start running low. In cycling terms... how long can you keep the legs delivering before they start filing complaints? For the next 90 minutes, we are going to find out! 😈🌋😈

This is a strong, spirited ride built around sustained work with plenty of opportunities to turn up the pressure. The group sets the rhythm, but when the right segment appears, consider that permission to have a little fun.

✅ Ride average watts: 2.2–>2.8 w/kg
✅ Duration: 90 minutes

We push on the climbs and designated segments, so expect the pace to get spicy throughout the ride. Make your move, test the legs, then fall back in quickly. The hard efforts are part of the fun, but keeping the group moving together is always the priority.

Respect the leader. Respect the group.
Work together between the pushes and be ready when it's time to go.

Extend the range. Hold the effort. Complete the mission.

BE LIMITLESS

#conqueringlimits #challengeaccepted #embracethesuck
www.usmilitaryesports.com

name: Velos Bumper Chase Race
description:
'Bumper' races prepare horses for the biggest events, so why not cyclists? And the name 'Chase' means 'to hunt' in old French, so join Velos for our newest event: 'The Bumper' Chase Race! We change courses weekly to keep it fresh, some weeks flat & others hilly... something for every taste.

A chase-style race is loads of fun because you work with others in your CAT to try and stay ahead of the faster riders. Wait for your group’s horn to sound: Ds take off first, then staggered starts release the Cs, Bs, and As from their pens with increasingly harder efforts required. If the group behind catches you, try to work with them to the finish. Each CAT wears a different kit, making it easier to see the group you are working to catch. Chase races help you learn how to work WITH a team, since a tighter bunch means a faster group. You will master team racing skills and get stronger whilst having fun along the way: the winning formula for ALL Velos events!

Join us at teamvelos.co.uk

name: VirtuSlo 4Endurance Race - Flat is Fast
description:
Welcome to our VirtuSlo 4Endurance Race. 
The Rules are simple: finish as fast as possible and have Fun!


PEN -> Zwift Racing Score

Pen B / 570 - 700
Pen C / 460 - 570

RULES AND RACE Settings
- No Powerups
- No TT Bikes
- Participants must be registered on zwiftpower.com to be included in the results
- Smart trainer or Power Meter required.
- Heart Rate Monitor required.
- No Indoor Bikes without Controlled Resistance (Cadence=Power)
- Sticky Watts or unusual pedalling technique to get an unrealistic advantage will result in DQ

MANDATORY REQUIREMENTS
- Zwift Activities must be saved PUBLIC for verification.
- Elite Level Performances above the limits stated below must be supported by DUAL POWER Recordings uploaded to Zwiftpower and with margin off error of less than 4%. Outside KOM efforts on Strava can be used for verification of Dual Power analysis.
*MEN: above 4.8W/kg or 350W for 20min, 5.5W/kg or 425W for 5min, 9W/kg for 1min.
**WOMEN: above 4.5W/kg or 280W for 20min, 5W/kg or 325w for 5min, 7.5W/kg for 1min.

WHAT IS ZWIFTPOWER?

description:
🇪🇸 🚴‍♂️☀️ SWEET & SUNNY CHILL RIDE by ZABI 🍩

¿Domingo por la tarde?

El sofá te está llamando… 🛋️Pero también te está llamando Zwift. 😎🚴‍♂️

Bienvenidos a la Sweet & Sunny Chill Ride by ZABI, un recorrido en grupo para disfrutar de unos kilómetros, charlar, reírnos un rato y pasar una buena tarde pedaleando juntos.

No es una carrera.No es un entrenamiento secreto.Y nadie está intentando descubrir quién es el próximo Pogačar. 😂

Solo queremos pasarlo bien en compañía.

🗺️ EL RECORRIDO

El recorrido está preparado y nos espera. 🚴‍♂️

Habrá kilómetros tranquilos, algún repecho y probablemente alguna subida que nos haga pensar:

“Bueno… esto no estaba en mis planes.” 😂

Y quizá aparezca algún sprint espontáneo.

Pero recuerda:

CHILL. RIDE.

Si de repente vas a 500 W…

👉 Nosotros no hemos visto nada. 👀😂

🧲 RUBBERBAND ON — KEEP TOGETHER

La idea es sencilla:

Rodamos juntos.

El ritmo se adapta al grupo, esperamos cuando hace falta y nadie se queda solo.

¿Hoy tienes piernas? Genial. 💪¿Hoy tus piernas están de vacaciones? También genial. 😂

Hay sitio para todos.

🍩 LAS REGLAS NO ESCRITAS

❌ Cero presión❌ Cero guerras de vatios❌ Cero necesidad de demostrar nada❌ Tomarnos demasiado en serio

✅ Buen ambiente✅ Mucho chat 💬✅ Muchas risas 😂✅ Kilómetros compartidos 🚴‍♀️🚴‍♂️✅ Compañerismo 🤝✅ Algún pique amistoso… porque somos ciclistas 😜

🎶 Así que deja el sofá durante un rato, enciende el rodillo y vente a Zwift.

Porque el domingo puede ser:

🛋️ “Hoy descanso.”

O puede ser:

☀️🚴‍♂️ “Bueno, una horita tampoco hace daño.” 😂

SWEET & SUNNY CHILL RIDE by ZABI

Sin presión. Sin carreras. Solo pedaleando juntos. 🧲🚴‍♂️🧡🩵

👇 ÚNETE A LA COMUNIDAD ZABI

🇬🇧 🚴‍♂️☀️ SWEET & SUNNY CHILL RIDE by ZABI 🍩

Sunday afternoon?

The sofa is calling… 🛋️But so is Zwift. 😎🚴‍♂️

Welcome to the Sweet & Sunny Chill Ride by ZABI — a relaxed group ride to enjoy some kilometres, have a chat, share a few laughs and spend your Sunday afternoon riding together.

It’s not a race.It’s not a secret training session.And nobody is trying to find out who the next Pogačar is. 😂

We’re just here to have a good time together.

🗺️ THE ROUTE

The route is ready. 🚴‍♂️

There’ll be some easy kilometres, a few bumps and probably a climb that makes you think:

“Well… that escalated quickly.” 😂

And there might even be a completely unnecessary sprint.

But remember:

CHILL. RIDE.

If you suddenly find yourself doing 500 watts…

👉 We saw nothing. 👀😂

🧲 RUBBERBAND ON — KEEP TOGETHER

The idea is simple:

We ride together.

The pace follows the group, we wait when needed and nobody gets left behind.

Feeling strong today? Great. 💪Legs not really cooperating? Also great. 😂

There’s room for everyone.

🍩 THE UNOFFICIAL RULES

❌ No pressure❌ No watt wars❌ No proving anything❌ No taking ourselves too seriously

✅ Good vibes✅ Plenty of chat 💬✅ Plenty of laughs 😂✅ Shared kilometres 🚴‍♀️🚴‍♂️✅ Good company 🤝✅ Maybe a little friendly competition… because we’re cyclists 😜

🎶 So leave the sofa for a while, jump on the trainer and join us on Zwift.

Because Sunday afternoon can be:

🛋️ “I’m resting today.”

Or…

☀️🚴‍♂️ “Well… one little ride won’t hurt.” 😂

SWEET & SUNNY CHILL RIDE by ZABI

No pressure. No racing. Just riding together. 🧲🚴‍♂️🧡🩵

And if someone accidentally launches a sprint…

That was definitely not part of the plan. 👀😂

name: TBR Power Up
description:
TBR Power Up is an hour long, all category friendly interval session. There are two intervals at approximately 2.5 watts/kg and one open watts interval.
We recover at our base pace of 1.8 wkg for 10 minutes between each interval.

We roll out at 1.8wkg to group up. Interval 1 is 7.5 minutes at 2.5 w/kg. Interval 2 is 10 minutes at 2.5w/kg. The final interval is The Wild Goose Race with no w/kg limit for 10 minutes to really test your mettle.

We don't use the fence for this ride as we believe all riders should exercise self-control and respect the ride leader by riding with the yellow beacon at all times. Your co-operation helps us provide everyone with a fun, supportive and inclusive ride.
Follow TBR at thebigring.cc to learn more about our events, read ride reports and leave feedback.

name: Zwift Racing League Recon Ride (ROC Race Team)
description:
This ZRL Group Recon Ride is led by ROC Race Team (https://www.zwift.com/clubs/b517310e-6009-4515-98e4-1cb4a0ed6331).

Zwift Racing League Group Recon Rides are the official non-competitive Group Rides. Each one is hosted/run by a participating club and will feature racing tips and tricks for the race ahead, an opportunity to ask questions relating to Zwift Racing League and to preview the full course for Tuesday’s ZRL races.

THE AIM
With experienced ride leaders and Zwifters from a reputable Zwift Club, this is your opportunity to ask questions about all things ZRL-related. You'll be able to learn useful course and team tactics and if you are new to ZRL - perhaps even find a team to race with too!

There are multiple Group Recon Rides to choose from each day at various times and each will operate at the advertised paces (pace is based on your Zwift Pace Group).

WHAT IS THE ZRL?
Introducing the spectacular Zwift Racing League (ZRL) - a turbocharged online bike racing extravaganza that's rewriting the rules of competition. With a staggering 180 community divisions, 1,800 electrifying teams, and a whopping 14,000 fierce racers per 6-week round, the ZRL stands as the undisputed heavyweight champion of online bike racing competitions worldwide.

This high-octane spectacle is masterfully orchestrated by our powerhouse partners, WTRL, who leave no stone unturned in delivering an unparalleled racing experience. But remember, this race is an invitation-only affair, so if you dare to join the ranks of speed demons and thrill-seekers, you'll need to hitch a ride with one of the esteemed existing teams. Fear not, though, for WTRL's website (www.WTRL.racing) is your portal to all the insider intel - schedule, rules, and even a team that perfectly aligns with your fiery spirit!

If you want to gather your own team, you register for the next Round of ZRL at www.wtrl.racing/zwift-racing-league/.

#zrlrecon #wtrl #zrl #rocraceteam

We are specialized in cycling vacations and when here with us, our guests will experience the culture and beauty of our location, the breath taking riding routes, the local cuisine and the wine tasting. We also offer combined tours to other iconic cycling destinations including Stelvio, Dolomites, Piedmont, Adriatic Coast, Rome, Tuscany and Lake Como.

The aim of this inclusive Zwift ride is to have fun, be friendly and connect with our growing community around the world. All of our rides will be led by one of our friendly professional cycling guide. The route will change every week and we will try to keep the ride at around 2.0 watts per kg to make sure everyone can join in and enjoy the fun. We are an official PINARELLO rental centre and on our Zwift rides we will be riding a beautiful Pinarello Dogma F12!

To find out more about Garda Bike Hotel, please visit our website at https://www.gardabikehotel.com/en

Facebook: Garda Bike Hotel
Instagram: gardabikehotel

name: Know No Bounds Ride
description:
Welcome to the #KnowNoBounds Ride! A ride where we explore the boundaries (or lack thereof) on Zwift.
The ride will begin with 30 minutes at 3 w/kg, utilizing the fence to keep riders together. At the end of the 30 minutes, riders are free to do as they please:
they can stay together and explore the chosen course for the day, or they can head off to the nearest mountain with friends and race it!

When the 30 minute "fenced" portion of the ride is over, we will #KnowNoBounds. Have bike, will travel.
If needed, you will be able to turn to ride in opposite direction on the circuit to reconnect with the group quicker (if you need restroom or are dropped),
and most importantly, the group is not limited to the in-game courses. We can choose to go up a mountain, along a riverside, or any road we want to!

We’re on a mission: to set everyday cyclists free to explore without limits. And we’re going by bike.

Community and camaraderie in cycling is everything: group chat on this ride is highly encouraged!

name: Torturefest | ITT Climbing League | Surrey Hills | Week 3
description:
ITT Climbing League where elevation is the target not distance. The clock runs from Pen to virtual banner finish. The routes have been designed to provide lots of world and climb variations to keep it interesting and challenging.

Week 1 Max Elevation 250 meters
Week 2 Max Elevation 450 meters
Week 3 Max Elevation 650 meters
Week 4 Max Elevation 850 meters
Week 5 when it rarely happens….Alpe Du Zwift

These races are not like the other KOM segment smash races, racing strategy comes to play. You will have to work different power ranges, manage energy levels and ponder bike choices. 
•	No draft regardless of bike.
•	No Power up’s just you and your watts.
•	Weekly distances will fluctuate, for example week 2 could be 15km and week 3 only 10km, elevation is primary focus.
•	Category enforced, must wear HRM.
•	ZwiftPower league in place for weekly and monthly results. Identical setup to zwift power.
•	Some weeks will have long lead-ins to the climb which creates the bike choice dilemma; TT bike, climbing bike or mid race bike change?
•	What is the intensity of your effort on each climb in a week where the course has multiple climbs?
•	How do you regulate your power on the flat sections before or between climbs?  

One week its long drag climbs, next week its multiple smaller climbs…weekly climbing Russian roulette style.

name: ZZRC Ride With Friends 1.3-1.5
description:
Welcome to our ZZRC Ride With Friends 1.5. This is a group ride, not a race, where we encourage riding together.

Our rides are open to all riders, the category enforcement merely allows us to ensure a safe and quality ride for you the riders and for our group.

In 2015 ZZRC was founded and are one of the oldest established clubs on Zwift .

YELLOW BEACON will pace between 1.3-1.5. on the ride , with a possible increase of watts on inclines or sprints , but the average for the whole ride will be 1.5

We strongly promote group riding so on most of our rides we will use the Fence to help encourage that. Using a fence ensures that the ride is not over paced .

In the event of falling off the back of the main group , you will need to pace well over group pace to bridge the gap and catch .

This is where our awesome ZZRC sweeps and Ride Buddies will help you return to group using their draft. They will give you clear encouraging instructions to aid this process .

Our crew are a caring bunch who dedicated a lot of hours to this club , but want you to have the best ride experience on Zwift

You will be fully supported and encouraged throughout the ride by the Leader, Sweeps and Ride Buddies .

Our rides do not allow the use of TT Bikes as they do not draft and will require you to push harder on the ride, and in these instances our Sweeps will not be able to help you .

Mountain bikes operate very similarly, minimum draft so more watts (effort) will be required for the ride and any chase backs to group .

All our rides have a 30 minute late join feature which allows you to rejoin if you have technical issues or you find yourself out of the group in the early stages of the ride. Using this feature SHOULD teleport you back into the main group with our YELLOW BEACON .

We love to have a chat on our rides so join us on our dedicated discord channel
https://discord.gg/teHeHABDHc

TOP TIPS
1) Stay close to the ride leader (or just in front on climbs), don’t let a gap form and the elastic snap!
2) Stay away from the Fence – We don’t like to fry anyone
3) Most important of all . . . HAVE FUN AND ENJOY THE RIDE.

#zzrc

Don’t forget to join our ZZRC-We Pace Not Race Facebook page and our club on the companion app

name: Team CLS Chill 'n' Spin Sunday Ride
description:
It’s time to join Team CLS for our Sunday Chill ‘n’ Spin ride… and UNLOCK our awesome Team CLS Kit.

Spin the legs and enjoy some banter. While stronger riders may choose to use this event as a recovery ride, this will also be an opportunity to get in a solid ride at mid D cat pace.

The focus is on riding with the bunch around the beacon as closely as possible. We see this ride as being a great event for riders that are:
- New to zwift, or have not tried a group ride before
- Recovering from injury
- Looking for a controlled group ride at D cat pace
- Easing back on the intensity and want a ride with plenty of chat.

Like all our events please make sure you can hold the above pace as we cannot reduce this at the expense of other riders although we will help to tow you back for dropouts etc.

WARNING - Please only attempt sneaky sprints on this ride if you feel your legs are sufficiently warmed up to do so. Sudden high intensity efforts on cold muscles is not advised.

name: Zwift Racing League Recon Ride (Galaxy CC)
description:
This ZRL Group Recon Ride is led by Galaxy CC (https://www.zwift.com/clubs/0d04ac16-6fad-4905-8407-98969e30595d).

Zwift Racing League Group Recon Rides are the official non-competitive Group Rides. Each one is hosted/run by a participating club and will feature racing tips and tricks for the race ahead, an opportunity to ask questions relating to Zwift Racing League and to preview the full course for Tuesday’s ZRL races.

THE AIM
With experienced ride leaders and Zwifters from a reputable Zwift Club, this is your opportunity to ask questions about all things ZRL-related. You'll be able to learn useful course and team tactics and if you are new to ZRL - perhaps even find a team to race with too!

There are multiple Group Recon Rides to choose from each day at various times and each will operate at the advertised paces (pace is based on your Zwift Pace Group).

WHAT IS THE ZRL?
Introducing the spectacular Zwift Racing League (ZRL) - a turbocharged online bike racing extravaganza that's rewriting the rules of competition. With a staggering 180 community divisions, 1,800 electrifying teams, and a whopping 14,000 fierce racers per 6-week round, the ZRL stands as the undisputed heavyweight champion of online bike racing competitions worldwide.

This high-octane spectacle is masterfully orchestrated by our powerhouse partners, WTRL, who leave no stone unturned in delivering an unparalleled racing experience. But remember, this race is an invitation-only affair, so if you dare to join the ranks of speed demons and thrill-seekers, you'll need to hitch a ride with one of the esteemed existing teams. Fear not, though, for WTRL's website (www.WTRL.racing) is your portal to all the insider intel - schedule, rules, and even a team that perfectly aligns with your fiery spirit!

If you want to gather your own team, you register for the next Round of ZRL at www.wtrl.racing/zwift-racing-league/.

#zrlrecon #wtrl #zrl #galaxy

name: The Grind Finale
description:
ABOUT THIS WORKOUT

This session aims to replicate the demands of a mountain bike ride / event. 

Mountain biking generally involves far more variations in effort compared with road riding - so plenty of surges and time spent being over geared! We also spend a lot of time on and off the power, so short spells going  hard to get over an obstacle, followed by a freewheel or very low power on a descent or little dip.

We touch upon all of these aspects in todays session, as we start off alternating every 30 seconds between riding hard at a low cadence, and riding easy - as if we are riding through an undulating single track. Then we make a ramp in effort, which finishes with a 30 second near max effort up a steep, rocky banking!

WORKOUT DESIGNER

Matt Rowe - Heavily involved in cycling for the past 25 years, Matt represented Great Britain at the Junior World Championships before graduating to the pro ranks. Matt draws on his extensive race experience to help amateur cyclists around the world achieve their personal goals. 

ABOUT GROUP WORKOUTS

Zwifters line up in the starting area just like a normal event and once the event starts, workout mode begins. Everyone stays together regardless of power output. That's right, if you're outputting 100W and another Zwifter is outputting 400W you will stay in exactly the same position relative to each other. Only if you stop pedaling and fall 6 meters behind the group will the rubber-banding stop. 

We highly recommend doing one of the FTP tests as the estimated FTP can be inaccurate and make the difficulty level of the workouts too high for your current fitness level. For more info on FTP go to: https://support.zwift.com/hc/en-us/articles/210208083-What-is-FTP-and-how-is-it-used-in-Zwift

name: EVO CC Sprint Race Series
description:
CATEGORY ENFORCEMENT IS ENABLED FOR ALL EVO RACES!

What is Category Enforcement? 

Category Enforcement will prevent Zwifters from entering a category they are not eligible for.  Our goal is to increase fairness in racing.

HOW DOES IT WORK?

- Zwift checks a racer's past performance using VO2 max and FTP to determine their race category.
- Racers can join a category at or above their category. For example, if you are "C" category, you can race in C, B, or A category. You will not be able to race in the D category and the option to join will be absent.

Welcome to EVO sprintrace series. Shorter more compact races for the rider looking for an effective high intensity race. Start fast, hang on in the middle, then sprint for the win at the finish. Expect to push your heart rate to its maximum. Sprinkle a few of these into your training plan and watch your fitness grow.

To make racing as fair as possible we have enforced a few minor rules that will result in automatic disqualification on ZwiftPower.

All riders must wear a heart rate monitor
Riding in an incorrect category.

zPower riders will be disqualified in A, B, and C Podium. zPower is allowed in the D category. Race details and final results will be available at www.zwiftpower.com

#evo

name: HCT Unleashed : Sunday Service
description:
Welcome to HCT Unleashed: Sunday Service.

The week is almost over. Have you paid your dues to the Cycling Gods? This is your final chance to empty the tank and find redemption in a short, sharp Sunday evening sufferfest.

The format is a chaotic mass start, with all categories unleashed at once. But here's the twist: while you can work with—or against—anyone on the course, your official results are only against riders in your own category.

Use the bunch to your advantage. Bridge a gap with a stronger rider or launch a late attack. It’s all part of the game. Join us every week for 20-40 minutes of tactical, high-octane racing.

If you like racing with HCT or are just looking for a racing community to get involved with, join the team on Zwift Power - ""Herts County Triathletes"" https://zwiftpower.com/team.php?id=19017 - and Captain Dan will be in touch to get you set up with the Discord Server. 
On the otherhand if you prefer some less intense involvement HCT also host a Z2 ride @ 3.15pm (GMT) on Saturdays. You can also join the Club on Zwift Companion App, and find us on YouTube, Facebook and Instagram.

Please note; for your results to show up in Zwift Power you must be using a Heart Rate Monitor (HRM) and be riding on a smart trainer, smart bike, or using a power meter.

name: Sunday Funday p/b TBR
description:
Come hang with some friendly peeps on TBR’s D-friendly ride! We roll together in a big, happy bunch at an average 2.0w/kg pace.

We don’t use the fence in favor of control and respect for the ride leader and listed pace. Our rides are fence free and whinge free, if you stick to the leader’s Yellow Beacon like a bear to honey you will enjoy the benefits of a group draft along with lots of friendly banter. We want you to have a happy spin on the bike!

We may be The Big Ring and known for powerful riders, but our tent is also big and we encourage riders comfortable at a social pace to meet our friendly crew and learn about the TBR Effect. We are all about supporting riders in a friendly environment and helping people feel comfortable gradually working up to a faster pace. At TBR, we love to help riders look inside themselves and discover the hidden power within.

Follow The Big Ring (TBR) at www.thebigring.cc

name: Zwift Racing League Recon Ride (Good Time Riders GTR)
description:
This ZRL Group Recon Ride is led by Good Time Riders GTR (https://www.zwift.com/clubs/10bd6884-1218-4698-af77-9fda887d4aa7).

Zwift Racing League Group Recon Rides are the official non-competitive Group Rides. Each one is hosted/run by a participating club and will feature racing tips and tricks for the race ahead, an opportunity to ask questions relating to Zwift Racing League and to preview the full course for Tuesday’s ZRL races.

THE AIM
With experienced ride leaders and Zwifters from a reputable Zwift Club, this is your opportunity to ask questions about all things ZRL-related. You'll be able to learn useful course and team tactics and if you are new to ZRL - perhaps even find a team to race with too!

There are multiple Group Recon Rides to choose from each day at various times and each will operate at the advertised paces (pace is based on your Zwift Pace Group).

WHAT IS THE ZRL?
Introducing the spectacular Zwift Racing League (ZRL) - a turbocharged online bike racing extravaganza that's rewriting the rules of competition. With a staggering 180 community divisions, 1,800 electrifying teams, and a whopping 14,000 fierce racers per 6-week round, the ZRL stands as the undisputed heavyweight champion of online bike racing competitions worldwide.

This high-octane spectacle is masterfully orchestrated by our powerhouse partners, WTRL, who leave no stone unturned in delivering an unparalleled racing experience. But remember, this race is an invitation-only affair, so if you dare to join the ranks of speed demons and thrill-seekers, you'll need to hitch a ride with one of the esteemed existing teams. Fear not, though, for WTRL's website (www.WTRL.racing) is your portal to all the insider intel - schedule, rules, and even a team that perfectly aligns with your fiery spirit!

If you want to gather your own team, you register for the next Round of ZRL at www.wtrl.racing/zwift-racing-league/.

name: TFC Group Group Ride Sub 2
description:
The TFC ride is open to all riders on Zwift, if you have not already, please opt in to Zwiftpower or you will not be included in the Zwiftpower results screen.
Please follow the yellow beacon who will be the designated ride lead and obey any instructions. Please ensure no TT bikes to benefit from the group draft.
C Group

The sweep team will try to pick up any dropped riders and bring them back to the group if they can hold 2.2-2.3wkg.
During the last lap the ride leader will call for a race to the flag. Wait for the ride leaders’ instructions before you go.

D Group

The D Group will be a Sub 2 W/Kg. The sweep team will pick up dropped riders and bring them back into the main pack. Remember this is the ride average so there will be times the group is slightly above the advertised W/Kg and times when it is below. Listen to the ride lead to ensure everybody is in the main group.

BEWARE - If you do drop off the back of the group you will need to ride at a considerable higher pace to get back to the group. The Sweep teams are there to tow you back on if you do drop off,
We will be on Discord: https://discord.gg/yU6Gkcu
If you’re interested in joining Team TFC please check out: www.facebook.com/groups/teamtfc

name: RollCo: Night Shift
description:
Night Shift is Rolling Collectives after-hours ritual race.

When the lights drop and the noise fades, this is where racing gets raw. Short, sharp courses. Mixed terrain.  No hiding behind long climbs or safe pacing. From the first pedal stroke, it’s on.
Night Shift is built for riders who race on feel and instinct. Attacks come hard, selections happen fast, and hesitation costs you. You don’t wait for the race to start, you make it.

This is late-night racing for those who like it intense, imperfect and alive. All in, after dark.

Why Join Rolling Collective?
We’re more than a club — we’re a global community of riders who support each other, grow together, and celebrate every ride, whether it’s a grind, a badge hunt, or a race. Join us on Discord, connect with fellow riders, and be part of something bigger.

Forward, Together

name: JETT Monday Morning Ride (2.5~3.0w/kg)
description:
Welcome to Japan eSports Tempting Team Monday Morning Ride !!
Power : ave 2.5w/kg〜3.0w/kg
Of course, ZWIFTer of all countries can participate. Leaders and heads pull groups at 2.5~3.0w/kg. Riders who are hard at the above power should try grouping by using drafting well.
If you leave the group behind, please offer with ""HELP !!"" and ZWIFT CAHT. Sweeper goes for support. Sweeper will not go for support unless he offers ""HELP !!"". Also, please offer within 10 seconds of time difference as much as possible.

Rule of this group ride
· You always keep grouping in mind( this is not a race )
· Do not Lead from Leader - yellow beacon
· Power Ups allowed ( do not use final Sprint )
· TT Bike allowed
Follow the leader's instructions, let's work together and make the best group, the best workout!

JETT Monday Morning Ride
パワー ave.2.5w/kg〜3.0w/kg
Japan Monday Morning Ride! もちろん、全ての国のZWIFTerが参加できます。 リーダーおよび先頭は2.5〜3.0w/kgでグループを引っ張ります。上記のパワーでは辛いというライダーはドラフティングをうまく活用してグルーピングにトライして下さい。
もし、集団から後方に離れてしまった場合、「HELP!!」とZWIFT CAHTで申し出てください。Sweeperが支援に向かいます。「HELP!!」の申し出がない限り、Sweeperは支援には行きません。また、可能な限りタイム差１０秒以内に申し出をお願いします。
このグループライドのルール
・常にグルーピングを心がけること(レースではありません）
・リーダーの黄色いビーコンよりも前に出ないこと（２０m以上）
・TT Bike OK
・スプリントはリーダー指示に従いましょう
50分のGroup Ride、リーダー指示に従い、みんなで協力して最高のグループ、最高のワークアウトにしましょう！
#JETT

name: Ascenders Team Asia Morning Group Run
description:
Come and join the Ascenders Team as we put on our running shoes and run
daily with our friends too by starting our day in a healthy way. Research
shows that just 30 minutes of running can have huge benefits on your
short-term and long-term health. So we designed our running events to
motivate athletes to run 30 minutes each day to boost your metabolism and
use those calories. Running will also help you look good and feel stronger.

Our group run is designed with runners of all levels in mind and set the
pace range to be determined by our Zwifter Runners. So find a group pace
that matches how you feel each day and make those steps count for you.
Runners who went beyond the event duration will find that we have selected
courses that will help you earn the Route Badges when you run the full
distance.

So lace up those running shoes as everybody is welcome to join with our
friendly and motivating runners.

# Join Ascenders Team on Facebook:

Come and join the fastest growing running club on Zwift.  With a choice of 5 or 10k you can pick your distance. Whether you are a beginner or experienced runner come and join us, you can run at whatever pace you like, it’s not a race unless you want it to be!

Each day is a different route and as new routes are released the courses will change to allow you to bag that badge.

You will run in our in game NPRC jersey and if you complete the event you get to keep it to wear wherever you like.

We also hold special events where you can win an actual jersey to wear in real life.

NPRC Facebook – We have a facebook group where you can join and talk about all things running.  Share your stories and get help and advice.

https://www.facebook.com/groups/1223724692417314/

NoblePro: - We are a team focused on elevating running through our treadmills and digital platforms. We create treadmills loved by runners and the wider running community for quality engineered hardware features and advanced software integration to give you the freedom to train with the apps you love.
https://www.noble-pro.com/

Kinni:- In a fitness world where treadmill bluetooth integration can be a confusing place, we aim to provide you with the ability to effortlessly connect. You can run structured treadmill workouts, connect and integrate with your favourite bluetooth fitness apps such as Zwift, Rouvy, Kinomaps and many more. We are focused on progress and advancement in integration, connectivity and control.
https://kinni.co/https://kinni.co/devices/ - To see if your treadmill is compatible to link to Zwift.

Join the NoblePro Running Club (NPRC) - https://www.zwift.com/clubs/e7829ccd-bce4-4244-9ccf-4cdc3ef148ff/home

name: Torturefest | ITT Climbing League | Surrey Hills | Week 3
description:
ITT Climbing League where elevation is the target not distance. The clock runs from Pen to virtual banner finish. The routes have been designed to provide lots of world and climb variations to keep it interesting and challenging.

Week 1 Max Elevation 250 meters
Week 2 Max Elevation 450 meters
Week 3 Max Elevation 650 meters
Week 4 Max Elevation 850 meters
Week 5 when it rarely happens….Alpe Du Zwift

These races are not like the other KOM segment smash races, racing strategy comes to play. You will have to work different power ranges, manage energy levels and ponder bike choices. 
•	No draft regardless of bike.
•	No Power up’s just you and your watts.
•	Weekly distances will fluctuate, for example week 2 could be 15km and week 3 only 10km, elevation is primary focus.
•	Category enforced, must wear HRM.
•	ZwiftPower league in place for weekly and monthly results. Identical setup to zwift power.
•	Some weeks will have long lead-ins to the climb which creates the bike choice dilemma; TT bike, climbing bike or mid race bike change?
•	What is the intensity of your effort on each climb in a week where the course has multiple climbs?
•	How do you regulate your power on the flat sections before or between climbs?  

One week its long drag climbs, next week its multiple smaller climbs…weekly climbing Russian roulette style.

name: Zwift Crit Racing Club - Volcano Circuit CCW
description:
It's Crit time! Come and join in the fun on a number of multi-lap short routes. Get ready to dig deep and push to the finish line!

What is Racing Score?

Racing Score is an intuitive system that replaces the traditional categories (A - D) with a 0-1000 scale to reflect your current level, considering various metrics like race performances and power. This score helps Zwift recommend the most competitive band to race in, ensuring a fun, rewarding, and exciting experience as you track your progression throughout your Zwift racing adventures.

WHAT IS ZWIFT POWER? For further information on connecting to Zwift Power check out this support page: https://support.zwift.com/en_us/connecting-to-zwiftpower-SyldRc_4H

Please note; for your results to show up in Zwift Power you must be using a Heart Rate Monitor (HRM) and be riding on a smart trainer, smart bike, or using a power meter.

name: ZLDR AYOP Event
description:
Start your day on the right foot or the left. Come to our 5k at your own pace (AYOP). Run, walk, chat, laugh and get your day moving on a positive note! Attitude is 90% of any situation so let’s make this day the best day and get you in the best mindset so you can be the best you!

ZLDR is a group of diverse people, from speed demons to walkers, from people just getting to their first 5k to ultra runners. We are here to support your running dreams and help you develop your running skills. We are a collective group of supportive and experienced runners and walkers who want to help you set and achieve new goals!

For more ZLDR fun and support, join our groups on social media platforms:

name: OTR Tempo Group Ride
description:
Come join OTR for our weekly Tempo Group Ride. Courses will rotate weekly on shorter circuit routes so slower riders off the back have a chance to rejoin the group. The Yellow Beacon ride leaders will guide you through a mix of sprints, tempo, and recovery laps. Be careful, the fence is live and will zap you if you fly off the front! The final lap is an optional race pace lap and a chance to give it all you got!

B group will focus on riding together at an average pace between 2.8 - 3.2 w/kg.
D group will focus on riding together at an average pace between 1.8 - 2.2 w/kg.

Join us for some conversation during the ride on our OTR discord channel at: https://discord.gg/WjY7EuAMv4

If you are interested in racing with OTR please reach out to any OTR team member. We are happy to help you meet your racing goals!

name: Torturefest | ITT Climbing League | Surrey Hills | Week 3
description:
ITT Climbing League where elevation is the target not distance. The clock runs from Pen to virtual banner finish. The routes have been designed to provide lots of world and climb variations to keep it interesting and challenging.

Week 1 Max Elevation 250 meters
Week 2 Max Elevation 450 meters
Week 3 Max Elevation 650 meters
Week 4 Max Elevation 850 meters
Week 5 when it rarely happens….Alpe Du Zwift

These races are not like the other KOM segment smash races, racing strategy comes to play. You will have to work different power ranges, manage energy levels and ponder bike choices. 
•	No draft regardless of bike.
•	No Power up’s just you and your watts.
•	Weekly distances will fluctuate, for example week 2 could be 15km and week 3 only 10km, elevation is primary focus.
•	Category enforced, must wear HRM.
•	ZwiftPower league in place for weekly and monthly results. Identical setup to zwift power.
•	Some weeks will have long lead-ins to the climb which creates the bike choice dilemma; TT bike, climbing bike or mid race bike change?
•	What is the intensity of your effort on each climb in a week where the course has multiple climbs?
•	How do you regulate your power on the flat sections before or between climbs?  

One week its long drag climbs, next week its multiple smaller climbs…weekly climbing Russian roulette style.

name: Mountain Massif structured training:  Tempo Efforts 2
description:
Created by Matteo Cigala, from Cigala Cycling, this structured training session is designed to help you cycle at a higher intensity.  For coaching and all your training needs visit https://coaching.cigalacycling.com/trainsmarterridefaster

About the session:
This session builds aerobic readiness, controlled tempo and threshold exposure, and sustained tempo endurance. The warm up prepares the athlete for early intensity changes. The tempo and threshold blocks elevate heart rate and activate muscular engagement without creating unnecessary fatigue. The main tempo sets focus on maintaining strong, steady power while holding a smooth, efficient cadence. Recovery intervals ensure quality and repeatability across all sets. The cool down supports gradual heart-rate reduction and full metabolic clearance.
Session details:
Warm Up 
5 min 40–65% CP 100–110 rpm

1 x Tempo 
3 min 80% CP Free cadence

1 x Threshold 
1 min 95% CP Free cadence

Recovery 
5 min 50–60% CP 100–110 rpm

3 x Tempo Sets 
8 min 75–90% CP 100–110 rpm
5 min recovery between sets 50–60% CP 90–100 rpm

Cool Down 
5 min 40–55% CP 100–110 rpm

Total Time: 58 minutes

Key coaching cues:
Keep transitions between intensities smooth and controlled. Hold steady power during tempo and threshold efforts without drifting upward. Maintain relaxed upper-body posture and consistent breathing. Use recoveries to reset cadence and technique before the next block. Stay focused on smooth, efficient pedalling during the longer tempo sets. 

Safety Note: 
Only undertake vigorous exercise if you are fit and healthy to do so. If you are at all unsure, consult a Physician or Doctor first. All training equipment including Bikes and Turbo trainers should be in full working order. Do not use any piece of equipment that does not come up to the required standard.
More information:
For more information check out the Mountain Massif website www.mountainmassif.com, follow on Instagram @mountain_massif, Facebook @mountainmassif and join our Zwift Club, by clicking the following link https://www.zwift.com/clubs/mountainmassif/home
To record all your training data and chart your progress, consider using the TrainingPeaks app or Vekta by following the link https://joinvekta.com/

name: 3R SPARK Steady State Ride [~2.0-2.2 w/kg avg]
description: This is a 3R Group Ride Event (not a race). 3R Spark runs five days a week and is designed to be an accessible and sociable training session, aimed primarily at riders in Cat-D. Different ride leaders target different effort levels and courses, with power averages in the range 2.0-2.5 W/kg. The wide spread reflects the diversity of rides. Mondays and Tuesdays are our entry-level steady-state rides, where we aim to hold a steady 2.0-2.2 throughout. Thursdays and Fridays are our interval sessions, designed to help Cat D riders push themselves a little further. For interval sessions we aim to average between 2.2-2.5 for the session, but there will be times above and below. Thursday and Friday sessions often include an optional mini-race at the end. Wednesday is the Taylor Zwift Fan Club ride, a led by the hosts of the popular podcast of the same name – expect a sociable steady-state session with lots to keep you entertained! The TZFC ride is livestreamed at twitch.tv/TaylorZwiftFC. Rides are typically around an hour long. Spark is a great introduction to group rides on Zwift, we are a friendly and supportive group who love to see one another succeed. We always have a sweeper (red beacon) whose wheel you can grab if you get dropped. There’s always plenty of good chat, via in-ride messages or on Discord. Come and join us! Join the 3R Facebook group for more info: https://www.facebook.com/groups/ClubWorldBicycleRelief/ #Team3R #3R #RideRaceRaise

name: 3R VOLT Interval Ride [~2.6-3.2 w/kg avg]
description:
This is a 3R Group Ride so please follow the leader beacon's (Yellow) instructions and if you are feeling strong, please help the keeper beacon (Red) to assist other riders back to the pack. 3R VOLT runs five days a week and is designed to provide a solid and fun training platform for riders.

Different ride leaders target different effort levels and courses, with power averages in the range 2.8-3.2 w/kg.

The wide spread reflects the diversity of rides and training needs, the following is a typical week:
Monday – After what has hopefully been a fun backed weekend on the bike, this our recovery session
Tuesday – Tends to be more of a classic interval session, riders usually finish with an average of around 3.0w/kg
Wednesday – We take to the hills and one of our tougher sessions with riders averaging around 3.2w/kg
Thursday – is our no red beacon ride and again tough interval sets and riders finishing around 3.2w/kg
Friday - is a little different, we don't take ourselves too seriously and often play a variety of games and quizzes along side the intervals and riders end up with around 2.8-3.0w/kg

The rides are typically around an hour long, but some may take up to 75mins with the majority finishing with either a ramp or a mini race.

The group welcomes rider interaction through messaging and the VOLT discord server and features a friendly bunch of regulars to which newcomers, and riders stepping up from lower intensity rides, are always welcome. name: Zwift Racing League Recon Ride (Black Horses eRT)
description:
This ZRL Group Recon Ride is led by Black Horses eRT (https://www.zwift.com/clubs/0db96f31-dc08-419f-abca-c768a8679687).

Zwift Racing League Group Recon Rides are the official non-competitive Group Rides. Each one is hosted/run by a participating club and will feature racing tips and tricks for the race ahead, an opportunity to ask questions relating to Zwift Racing League and to preview the full course for Tuesday’s ZRL races.

THE AIM
With experienced ride leaders and Zwifters from a reputable Zwift Club, this is your opportunity to ask questions about all things ZRL-related. You'll be able to learn useful course and team tactics and if you are new to ZRL - perhaps even find a team to race with too!

There are multiple Group Recon Rides to choose from each day at various times and each will operate at the advertised paces (pace is based on your Zwift Pace Group).

WHAT IS THE ZRL?
Introducing the spectacular Zwift Racing League (ZRL) - a turbocharged online bike racing extravaganza that's rewriting the rules of competition. With a staggering 180 community divisions, 1,800 electrifying teams, and a whopping 14,000 fierce racers per 6-week round, the ZRL stands as the undisputed heavyweight champion of online bike racing competitions worldwide.

This high-octane spectacle is masterfully orchestrated by our powerhouse partners, WTRL, who leave no stone unturned in delivering an unparalleled racing experience. But remember, this race is an invitation-only affair, so if you dare to join the ranks of speed demons and thrill-seekers, you'll need to hitch a ride with one of the esteemed existing teams. Fear not, though, for WTRL's website (www.WTRL.racing) is your portal to all the insider intel - schedule, rules, and even a team that perfectly aligns with your fiery spirit!

If you want to gather your own team, you register for the next Round of ZRL at www.wtrl.racing/zwift-racing-league/.

#zrlrecon #wtrl #zrl #blackhorsesert

name: Torturefest | ITT Climbing League | Four Horsemen | Week 4
description:
ITT Climbing League where elevation is the target not distance. The clock runs from Pen to virtual banner finish. The routes have been designed to provide lots of world and climb variations to keep it interesting and challenging.

Week 1 Max Elevation 250 meters
Week 2 Max Elevation 450 meters
Week 3 Max Elevation 650 meters
Week 4 Max Elevation 850 meters
Week 5 when it rarely happens….Alpe Du Zwift

These races are not like the other KOM segment smash races, racing strategy comes to play. You will have to work different power ranges, manage energy levels and ponder bike choices. 
•	No draft regardless of bike.
•	No Power up’s just you and your watts.
•	Weekly distances will fluctuate, for example week 2 could be 15km and week 3 only 10km, elevation is primary focus.
•	Category enforced, must wear HRM.
•	ZwiftPower league in place for weekly and monthly results. Identical setup to zwift power.
•	Some weeks will have long lead-ins to the climb which creates the bike choice dilemma; TT bike, climbing bike or mid race bike change?
•	What is the intensity of your effort on each climb in a week where the course has multiple climbs?
•	How do you regulate your power on the flat sections before or between climbs?  

One week its long drag climbs, next week its multiple smaller climbs…weekly climbing Russian roulette style.

name: ZZRC Bring a Bidon Social Ride
description:
Welcome to our ZZRC Bring a Bidon 2.4-2.7. This is a group ride, not a race, where we encourage riding together.

Our rides are open to all riders, the category enforcement merely allows us to ensure a safe and quality ride for you the riders and for our group.

In 2015 ZZRC was founded and are one of the oldest established clubs on Zwift .

YELLOW BEACON will pace between 2.4-2.7 on the ride , with a possible increase of watts on inclines or sprints , but the average for the whole ride will be as advertised

We strongly promote group riding so on most of our rides we will use the Fence to help encourage that. Using a fence ensures that the ride is not over paced .

In the event of falling off the back of the main group , you will need to pace well over group pace to bridge the gap and catch .

This is where our awesome ZZRC sweeps and Ride Buddies will help you return to group using their draft. They will give you clear encouraging instructions to aid this process .

Our crew are a caring bunch who dedicate a lot of hours to this club , but want you to have the best ride experience on Zwift

You will be fully supported and encouraged throughout the ride by the Leader, Sweeps and Ride Buddies .

Our rides do not allow the use of TT Bikes as they do not draft and will require you to push harder on the ride, and in these instances our Sweeps will not be able to help you .

Mountain bikes operate very similarly, minimum draft so more watts (effort) will be required for the ride and any chase backs to group .

All our rides have a 30 minute late join feature which allows you to rejoin if you have technical issues or you find yourself out of the group in the early stages of the ride. Using this feature SHOULD teleport you back into the main group with our YELLOW BEACON .


We love to have a chat on our rides so join us
on Discord: https://discord.gg/QdeS3PtXTX


TOP TIPS

1) Stay close to the ride leader (or just in front on climbs), don’t let a gap form and the elastic snap!

2) Stay away from the Fence – We don’t like to fry anyone

3) Most important of all . . . HAVE FUN AND ENJOY THE RIDE.

#zzrc

Don’t forget to join our ZZRC-We Pace Not Race Facebook page and our club on the companion app

name: ZTBR - Training Stabilization TTT
description:
Zwift Teams Brazil [ZTBR] together with Assessoria Franklin Almeida, provides this training with a focus on providing better "Stabilization" in the performance of athletes seeking better performance in Team Time Trial (TTT) events.

This training aims to help the athlete tolerate and withstand an accumulation of substrates produced by the body in sub-maximal activities, bringing more stability and control in time-based tests.

Franklin Almeida Consulting was created in 2005, with the aim of evaluating the physiological profile, developing training to improve your physical capacity, health and maximum performance.
One of the pioneers in distance consulting in Brazil!

Note: We will have other phases of this training in addition to Stabilization, they are: (Training for FTP Gains and Terrain Variations).

===
Português:
Treino de Estabilização by Franklin Almeida

Descrição: O Zwift Teams Brazil [ZTBR] juntamente com a Assessoria Franklin Almeida, disponibiliza este treino com foco em proporcionar melhor "Estabilização" na performance de atletas que buscam um melhor desempenho nos eventos tipo Team Time Trial (TTT).

Esse treino tem o objetivo de ajudar o atleta a tolerar e suportar um acúmulo de sustratos produzidos pelo organismo em atividades sub máximas trazendo mais estabilidade e controle em provas de conta relógio.

A Consultoria Franklin Almeida foi criada em 2005, com o objetivo de avaliar o perfil fisiológico, desenvolver treinos para melhorar sua capacidade física, sua saúde e desempenho máximo.
Um dos pioneiros em consultoria a distância no Brasil!

Obs.: Teremos outras fases deste treinamento além da Estabilização, são elas: (Treino para Ganhos de FTP e Variações de terreno).

name: DIRT 505 Monday Endurance Ride
description:
Welcome to the DIRT 505 Monday Endurance Ride!

Please join us weekly on Mondays at a pace of 2.6-2.8w/kg for 90 minutes.

The 505 rides take place Monday, Wednesday, Thursday and Friday for 90 minutes at the same time and same consistent pace. Saturday's we ride for 120 minutes.

We kick off our rides with a 5 minute pace at 2.2w/kg to get us warmed up and together as a team. The fence is used throughout the ride to keep everyone together. The fence will not kick you off the ride but we do encourage all our riders to stay together as close to the beacon as possible. Our rides offer a 30 minute late join option.
The ride leader will stay as close to ride pace as possible. We try to change up the routes each week and some of the routes may include some small to moderate climbs.

Our group exists to encourage and build up cyclists around the world no matter your time zone, fitness level, pro or amateur. We exist to encourage and build up a team culture of unity in the cycling community.

Enjoy the steady pace of around 1.8w/kg while having a social chat, let us know what you got up to over the weekend as we ride together. It’s a great introduction to group riding with full pace instructions via text and voice chat using discord with sweeps helping at the back. You can sign up early via the web or mobile app and late join is enabled.

All riders will appear in the same kit and you can optionally add (PACK) after your name to show support of the group. Please respect the pace set by the leader, this is a group ride not a race. #strongertogether

Finally, if you are just starting your zwift experience, please join our facebook group and PACK Club for tips on group riding, friendly advice and to answer any questions you have.

name: Brownlee Fitness Hare & Hounds
description:
Brownlee Fitness welcomes you to a Monday hare and hounds style event where 4 groups leave at 1 minute intervals and try to catch the group in front. Work together with your group to stay ahead or catch the group in front. 

A great way to build some fitness ahead of race season.

name: GRIT Easy Ride
description:
The ride will begin with a warm-up around 2.5 w/kg for 5-10 minutes. After the warm-up, the beacon will increase the pace to 3.0-3.2 w/kg. Riders are asked to respect the beacon, stay with the group, and enjoy a relaxing spin. Help keep the peloton together by limiting power on hills and maintaining a moderate pace.
Optional: Use this ride to warm up for GRIT’s Micro Madness Group Workout. This HIIT-style workout immediately follows Easy Ride and can help you add a dose of intensity to your riding routine.
Embrace your inner easy and start your week with GRIT!
GRIT: Great Rides for Intense Training

eventSubgroups.name: GRIT Easy Ride (B)
eventSubgroups.description:
This is planned as a recovery ride to allow riders to ride an easy pace after some hard weekend events.

All our GRIT rides start with an easy warmup pace around 2.5 w/kg for about 10 minutes. All riders are asked to stay together during this warmup section. Please help the group by keeping the peloton together during this warmup section. Ride at an easy pace at the front to avoid riders falling off the back.

After the warmup, all riders are asked to ride at 3.0 w/kg. This is an easy ride to help with recovery from weekend events. Please help us keep the group together at this easy pace of 3.0 w/kg.
This will be a fun social event so plan to enjoy a workout with friendly riders. We will limit power on hills to keep riders together.

name: KISS at Base Training Ride
description:
Join us to work on your endurance and power output at your aerobic threshold (AT) in Zone 2. The exercise will give you endurance and increased performance using fat as energy. A well-developed AT can give you better race performance increase the amount of time before your body uses glycogen stores.

We are now offering four separate paced rides to better accommodate various fitness levels. 
The A cat is for riders with zone 2 higher than 3.99
The B cat is for riders with Zone 2 between 3.2 - 3.99 w/kg. 
The C cat is for riders with Zone 2 between 2.5 - 3.19 w/kg.
The D cat is for riders with Zone 2 between 2.0 - 2.5 w/kg.

Remember this when you approach hills and inclines along the way. Stick together to enjoy the draft and companionship. The ride leader will not exceed the advertised pace at any time - even on hills. Please keep an eye on the leader beacon (yellow) and the sweeper beacon (red) to stay in the blob.

So turn on your graph (press G on computer keyboard or select it from on-screen menu in iOS and Android) and paint it blue. Give the body a good foundation for Zwift racing. Discord server Link: https://discord.gg/kBmXhY2

name: The HERD M2C2
description:
JOIN THE MONDAY MORNING COFFEE CREW!

New to Zwift? Raced hard over the weekend? Just need reason to get moving on a Monday? Join The Herd for the most chill ride on Zwift served with coffee (virtual, of course). This ride is the perfect place to start if you want to become a stronger rider and gain the knowledge and confidence to try other group rides and even the races or tours that fill the Zwift Events calendar.

name: CRYO-GEN Wheelie Fun Recovery Ride
description:
Join CRYO-GEN for a recovery spin designed to wake the legs up, flush them out, and leave you feeling better than when you started.

We’ll stay mostly in the gray zone with a cadence of 80+ rpm. On small inclines, please go sub 2. Remember to gear down, and spin up to keep the effort light. The focus is on a smooth pedal stroke, good form, and steady blood flow to support recovery. The red beacon will roll at a more relaxed pace if needed.

This is a social, supportive ride where the goal isn’t speed — it’s recovery.

There are no sweepers on this ride so everyone can stay comfortably in their own recovery zone. This is your ride — spin easy, chat, and do what works for you, as long as you’re truly recovering.

Think of this as the perfect reset to get you ready for your next workout, race, or climb.

Come spin the legs and start the week feeling good. 🚴‍♀️

HEALTH: We would advise any rider who is attempting a Zwift ride for the first time to ensure that their health should always take precedence over completing any ride. If you feel unwell or unable to continue please STOP

NOTE: Exercise contributes to 25% weight loss; Healthy Eating (Not Diet) contributes to the other 75%. Be fit and Healthy.

name: TEAM ITALY From Walk to Run 5K
description:
WELCOME TO ALL RUNNERS! 5Km running is your goal? This is a Run-Walk-Run event, that which will help you to start running, to return after an injury, to increase your training or simply to train for weelness. The event is structured as workouts to give you the opportunity to manage the paces according to your personal pace references for a functional aerobic improvement training. Each workout will include initial walking warm up, so please set your treadmills to exit the starting pen all in group walking and follow the subsequent messages on the screen. The Running Division of Team Italy is a new reality that is added to the already more acclaimed Bike Division. It was born from the passion between two runner friends, zwift users, and boss of Team, which we thanks. So, we hope you enjoy with us. Also in the other events, which you can find on our Facebook page. Please, add tag [ITA] after your name. name: Epictour - Structured Workout
description:
#Startyourweek with Epictour!

This is a short and intense ride! Our ride leader, Josh, will lead you through a 45min interval workout, with intervals at over your FTP value between 105% and 120%. Rubberband is in effect so that no matter how many watts you push, everyone will stick together. 

We are a friendly and welcoming bunch that like to work hard - if you've never ridden an Epictour ride, today is great day to start! 

This event is recurring. Same time next week with a new workout! 

Notes: 

- You will default to ERG mode.  If you prefer your smart trainer to not auto adjust resistance, deselect ERG in the menu before the ride to bring you to SIM mode ( https://support.zwift.com/en_us/erg-mode-in-workouts-SkQJC8OEH )

- The displayed peloton speed will be slower than anticipated. This will not affect your workout, but it is a quirky feature.

Join us on Discord: https://discord.gg/QK9vVdFjUJ

If you have questions about tech set-up for zwift or cycling in general, please feel free to message us on our social platforms, we would be happy to help you where we can!

https://www.instagram.com/epictourgranfondo/
https://www.facebook.com/Epictourgranfondo
https://www.strava.com/clubs/epic-tour
